rabbi-shimon-ben-yehotzadak.name: Rabbi Shimon ben Yehotzadak
rabbi-shimon-ben-yehotzadak.era: Sage · Land of Israel, early 3rd century
rabbi-shimon-ben-yehotzadak.bio: Sage of the Land of Israel at the turn from the Tannaim to the Amoraim, whose teachings Rabbi Yoḥanan transmits.
rabbi-shimon-ben-yehotzadak.prompt: An elderly sage in his 70s with a long white beard and a calm, kindly face, wrapped in a plain cream mantle. Background: a Galilean courtyard with an olive tree and limestone walls in soft evening light.

rabbi-natan.name: Rabbi Natan
rabbi-natan.bio: Rabbi Natan the Babylonian, son of the Exilarch, who served as head of the court in the time of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel.
rabbi-natan.prompt: A dignified scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard touched with grey and a rich deep-blue mantle hinting at his noble Babylonian family. Background: the arches of the court at Usha in warm light.

rava-bar-sheila.name: Rava bar Sheila
rava-bar-sheila.bio: Babylonian Amora, cited here passing on Shmuel’s teaching through Rav Mattana.
rava-bar-sheila.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a neat brown beard and a simple dark headwrap, speaking with a thoughtful look. Background: a mud-brick study house beside palm trees on the Euphrates.
